name: warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-not-activatable-without-warrior
notes: Warrior of the Fae Realm (eRcqucBKhX): "As long as you control CARDNAME, you may activate the banished card on a later turn." Negative case for the 'as long as you control' condition: a Striking Tides is seeded in player 1's banishment already carrying both permission tags (_warriorFaeRealm and the later-turn stamp, i.e. exactly what a prior turn's real banish leaves), but player 1 controls no Warrior of the Fae Realm. On player 1's next turn the click is accepted as a no-op (an FSM click that matches no branch is not rejected, so the refusal is asserted on state): the card stays in banishment, hand and memory unchanged. CAVEAT: the tags are seeded (not produced through real play) so this fixture proves only the Warrior-on-field gate; the tag lifecycle is proven through real play by the two sibling fixtures.

rulesClauses: As long as you control Warrior of the Fae Realm, you may activate the banished card on a later turn.
